title: PriceUpdate
description: Published by the pricing agent to retail/price/{product_id} on every price decision. QoS 1, retained, so an edge node that reboots immediately receives the current price.

product_id.description: Must equal the {product_id} segment of the topic it is published on.

price.description: Decided price. Two decimal places. Consumers must parse as decimal, never float.

decision_id.description: Join key. The matching ExplainVector carries the same decision_id, as does the audit row.

reason_tag.description: Human-readable headline reason, e.g. 'Inventory high'. Rendered verbatim on LCD line 2 of a 16x2 character display, so the 16 character limit is a hardware constraint, not a style preference.

agent_version.description: Identifies which agent produced the decision, e.g. 'stub-0.1' or 'dqn-2026-10-03'. Required for the evaluation chapter: results must be attributable to a specific policy.
